hook: Your money is losing $400 a year right now.

beats.overlay: Your money is losing $400 a year right now.
beats.vo: And it is sitting in your checking account.
If your savings sit in a normal checking account, the bank is using your money for free.

Move it to a high-yield savings account. Same safety, same insurance, but instead of zero you earn around four percent. Ten thousand dollars makes you four hundred dollars for doing absolutely nothing, and you can still pull it out any time.
Leave one month of expenses in checking for bills, and park the rest in the high-yield account.

cta.vo: Save this and follow. Free money is the easiest money.
